title: G01: reconcile desktop/runtime docs with what is built
body: Source: [T3 Code gap analysis](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/research/2026-09-30-t3code-gap-analysis.md), slice G01 (P1, small). Bring README/audit/surface claims in line with the code after the 2026-09-30 desktop landings (#10020–#10029, #10055–#10063): platform limits, notification support per OS, settings, accessibility, Windows/Linux status. Check links. Acceptance: claims match code; links checked.
